referenceStyle.title: Reference style
referenceStyle.body: Give Jarvis a finished short you like — upload it or paste its link — and it measures how that video was edited (cuts, captions, music, colours, hook) and saves it as a style you can pick in the style menu above.
referenceStyle.basedOnCloseCall: Closest pacing match: {niche} — nearly tied with {runnerUp}
referenceStyle.notInferredTitle: Couldn't be measured — inherited from the base style

cleanupBody: Tighten dead air and cut filler sounds while rendering.
shortenPausesHint: Trim silences longer than this down to a short breath
extraWords: Extra words or phrases to cut
limitNote: {plan}: YouTube, Twitch, and Kick videos up to {minutes} minutes. Each video uses its length in minutes, checked before we start.
uploadLimits: Uploads up to {size}. Videos above 1080p or 60 fps are scaled down automatically, keeping their shape.
completionEmails: Completion emails follow your preference in <settings>Settings</settings>.
recentEmpty: Your clips will show up here. Paste a link above to make your first batch.
previewCaptions: This is how your captions look

nudge.startTitle: Pick a plan to start clipping
nudge.startDescription: From {price}/mo for {length} of video a month. Feel free to set everything up first.
nudge.limitTitle: You've used all {length} of video this month
nudge.limitWithPlan: {refreshes} Or keep going with {plan}: {limit} of video a month.
nudge.limitAppStore: {refreshes} You can change plans in the SnipNova iOS app.

nudge.nearWithPlan: {refreshes} Need more room? {plan} gives you {limit} of video a month.
nudge.limitTitleAll: You've used this month's video minutes

clipLength.title: Clip length
clipLength.hint: Target length before pause and filler removal. Your choice is saved as your default.
clipLength.saveError: Could not save your default. This video will still use your choice.

clipCount.title: Number of clips
clipCount.hint: Auto picks a sensible number for the video's length. A fixed number is a target, never a promise: if the video has fewer distinct worthwhile moments, you get those instead of duplicates.

contentBrief.title: Campaign brief
contentBrief.body: Tell Jarvis the rules a campaign or sponsor set for this video — what must be mentioned, what the clips must focus on, and which parts of the video may be used. A moment that breaks a mandatory rule is never turned into a clip.
contentBrief.requirementPlaceholder: e.g. Expedia must be a major focus of the content
contentBrief.kindLabel: Is this requirement mandatory or optional?

types.structure_cta: Call to action near the end

contentBrief.ctaPhrasesPlaceholder: e.g. use code CREATOR, link in bio
contentBrief.namesLabel: Names that must be spelled right (comma separated)
contentBrief.infoOnlyNote: Info only — kept for reference, never checked automatically.
contentBrief.rangesBody: Only footage inside these ranges can be used. Leave empty to use the full video.

rangeErrors.invalidEnd: Enter an end time like 3:10:00, or leave it empty for “to end”.
rangeErrors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

contentBrief.pasteBody: Paste the rules from the campaign page and Jarvis drafts the requirements for you. Nothing is used until you review the draft and choose “Use this draft”.
contentBrief.extractFailed: Could not extract a brief from that text
contentBrief.extractedByModel: Extracted by model — review before creating
contentBrief.campaignLoaded: Loaded the saved brief from {name}. Edits here affect this generation only, unless you save them back.
contentBrief.campaignLoadFailed: Could not load that campaign's brief
contentBrief.campaignExampleNote: This campaign has an example video: it will be used as the reference style for this generation unless you pick your own style above.
contentBrief.saveToCampaign: Save this brief to the campaign
contentBrief.campaignSaveFailed: Could not save the brief to the campaign

summary.title: What will be enforced
summary.barCaption: checked against the generated captions and title text
summary.barVisual: checked by a model judgement on the clip — may come back uncertain
summary.barHook: a hook must land within the first {seconds}s
summary.barCta: a call to action must appear near the end
summary.referenceFromCampaign: Reference style: from the campaign example link
summary.enforcement: No clip will contain footage outside these ranges. If no moment satisfies every mandatory requirement, no clips will be made.
summary.enforcementNoRanges: If no moment satisfies every mandatory requirement, no clips will be made.
summary.enforcementExcluded: Footage in the never-use ranges is hard-blocked from every clip.

contentBrief.imageBody: Upload a screenshot of the campaign brief (PNG, JPG or WebP). Jarvis reads the text on this device and drafts the brief — nothing is used until you review the draft and choose “Use this draft”.
contentBrief.imageDraftNote: Read {characters} characters from the screenshot. The recognised text is in the box above — check it before using the draft.
contentBrief.draftCountsExtra: Also drafted: {excluded} never-use ranges · {flags} flag points · {keys} key timestamps
contentBrief.excludedBody: Footage inside these ranges is hard-blocked — no clip will ever contain it.
contentBrief.keysBody: Moments the campaign itself names. Jarvis builds candidate clips around them.
contentBrief.keyDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. How diamonds helped transform Botswana
contentBrief.maxKeys: At most 20 key timestamps per brief.
contentBrief.flagsBody: A clip containing one of these moments is stamped “needs review” so you can check it yourself (for example a licence plate or a logo). Nothing is blurred or changed automatically.
contentBrief.maxFlags: At most 40 flag points per brief.
